problem:
Which of the following vector functions are continuous on $[1,4]?$

 

$$
\begin{aligned}p(s) & =\frac{1}{{s}^{2}}\,i+\frac{s}{\operatorname{ln}⁡s}\,j+(s+1)\,k \\ q(s) & =s{e}^{s}\,i+{s}^{2}{e}^{s}\,j-\frac{s}{{e}^{s}}\,k \\ r(s) & =\sqrt{s}\,i+(2-{s}^{2})\,j+s\operatorname{ln}⁡s\,k\end{aligned}
$$

choices.value: All of the functions are continuous on $[1,4]$
None of the functions are continuous on $[1,4]$

activity_context.topic_title: Continuity and Differentiability of Vector-Valued Functions
